stem:
Gita lists substances a plant may use in respiration: glucose, oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, and water. Energy may be released even when conditions change. Green leaves and non-green roots are both living parts that can carry out respiration.

Which statement about respiration is correct?

options.text: Glucose reacts with oxygen in all parts, releasing carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
Glucose reacts with nitrogen in all parts, releasing carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
Glucose releases carbon dioxide, water, and energy even when no oxygen is available.
Only green parts carry out respiration; non-green roots do not.

teacher.key_rationale: Respiration: glucose with oxygen releases carbon dioxide, water, and energy in all plant parts.
